meta.label: REAL USGS gauge pairs, held-out 2024–2026 events
meta.claim: lead time gained at the downstream site by running the agent's alert rule on the upstream gauge as well
meta.data_source: USGS NWIS instantaneous gauge height (00065), U.S. public domain, credit U.S. Geological Survey; NWS action stages from NOAA NWPS where the datum check passed. U.S. rivers, not Nepal/India.

definitions.event: downstream raw stage crosses warning from below, stays >= warning for 2 readings, and was below warning for the previous 24 h
definitions.window: upstream alert onset counts for a downstream event if it falls in [t_cross - W, t_cross], W = clip(3 x TRAIN median travel time, 1 h, 48 h), and after the downstream last fell below warning
definitions.false_alert: an upstream alert episode is false if the downstream raw stage does not reach its warning level within W after the episode onset; a downstream-only episode is false if it does not reach warning within 6 h
definitions.gain: t_alert(downstream-only) - t_alert(combined), combined = min(upstream-driven, downstream-only); if the downstream-only rule has not fired by t_cross + 6 h its time is capped there
definitions.camera_noise: Gaussian noise (sigma 5 cm) added to the upstream readings, filter told sigma = 5 cm; downstream stays a gauge
definitions.travel_time: per TRAIN downstream P95 event: lag maximising the cross-correlation of the positive hourly rises (1-h trailing mean) of upstream vs downstream; median over events
